## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this approach was chosen.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] Existing `.agent` files remain compatible, or a migration is documented.
- [ ] New network, credential, filesystem, or side-effect behavior is explicit.
- [ ] Tests cover success and failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] A changeset is included when a published package changes.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private cloud source, or incompatible code is included.
